visualCharacteristics.description: Scroll-driven sticky full-bleed background photos that cross-fade per step. Each slide overlays a translucent card. The first (title-only) card is centered with a display h2; the others are left-aligned with an uppercase h3 + one sentence. No arrows/dots. Same sticky-photo overlay on mobile; scroll-linked crossfade and slow zoom-in (scale 1 to 1.2) per photo.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: [background image] | [heading + optional paragraph/CTA]; a heading-only text cell becomes a centered title slide
